const doubler: { double(): number } & ThisType<{ value: number }> = {
  double() {
    return this.value * 2;
  },
};
console.log(doubler.double.call({ value: 4 }));

const obj = { value: 3 };
Object.defineProperty(obj, "double", {
  get(): number {
    return this.value * 2;
  },
});
console.log((obj as { value: number } & { double?: number }).double);

function define<D, M>(desc: { data: D; methods: M & ThisType<D & M> }): D & M {
  return Object.assign({}, desc.data, desc.methods);
}
const made = define({
  data: { x: 1 },
  methods: {
    add(y: number) {
      return this.x + y;
    },
  },
});
console.log(made.add(2));

type Outer = { inner: { read(): number } } & ThisType<{ base: number }>;
const outer: Outer = {
  inner: {
    read() {
      return this.base;
    },
  },
};
console.log(outer.inner.read.call({ base: 7 }));

const counter: { n: number; inc(): number } = {
  n: 0,
  inc() {
    this.n += 1;
    return this.n;
  },
};
counter.inc();
console.log(counter.inc());

const plain = {
  n: 1,
  next() {
    return this.n + 1;
  },
};
console.log(plain.next());

const loose: { m(): string } & ThisType<any> = {
  m() {
    return String(this.anything);
  },
};
console.log(loose.m());
